programmes.d: Following a strange dream, Yuko Yoshida wakes up to find she has grown demon horns and a tail; her mother Seiko reveals that their family are the descendants of a dark clan who live in poverty because of the opposing light clan.
Momo needs to process the shocking revelations that rocked her to the core! Perhaps Yuko can solve the dilemma by offering Momo a deal with a demon girl.
Yuko challenges Momo to a battle during the weekend, which ends up turning into an all-day running session; another demon girl prepares to set Yuko back on the right path.
Misaki, the iron-fisted student council president, hides a secret: she works in a maid cafe! She's discovered by the most popular guy in school; what's his price for silence?
Yuko's demon ancestor Lilith appears in her dream to give her some advice, only for her to forget everything she said when she wakes up.
Misaki's secret is spreading; now the Three Idiots are onto her too! Worse, the school festival's coming, and Class 2-2's about to rebel! One single mistake could expose her!
Momo discovers a switch on the bottom of the statue that Yuko carries around; upon being flipped, it gives Lilith the opportunity to possess Yuko's body.
It's Little Sister Day at the cafe. Misaki can't get into the role, but a severe scolding by Honoka makes her turn her act around. Misaki nails the parté until Takumi arrives.
Yuko buys a camera with the money she was going to use to pay off her debt.
The cafe gets a celebrity guest: Aoi, a net idol. She's eager to work in the cafe, much to Satsuki's chagrin. When Takumi helps out in the kitchen, Aoi sets her sights on him!
Lilith sends Yuko into Momo's subconscious, where she ends up tidying the dark muck surrounding her dreams.
Satsuki warns Misaki about a group of stalkers targeting cosplay cafes, but she isn't worried. On this night, however, the boss is late and Misaki has to close shop alone.
The Yoshida family celebrate by holding an okonomiyaki party after discovering that Yuko's actions have lifted the curse limiting their family to a tight monthly budget.
Misaki has new fans at school- the Inuyama brothers. They want to know all about her, but this will reveal her secret. Should she tell them the truth and risk her reputation?
The magical girl, Mikan Hinatsuki, is called by Momo to assist her with Yuko's training; Yuko learns that magical girls disappear if they use up all of their magic.
Misaki breaks up a fight between students from Seika High and Miyabigaoka Academy. When she brings the Seika students to Miyabigaoka to apologize, Takumi tags along.
Wanting Momo to take her more seriously, Yuko proposes a friendly duel to determine who can score best on history during the final exams.
Misaki's torn over Miyabigaoka's surprise offer. When she finally goes to give her reply, her friends worry Seika High wouldn't be where it is today without her.
Yuko's occult-obsessed classmate, Sion Ogura, brings her and Momo to the Black Magic Studies Lab to try some experiments on Lilith's statue.
Takumi narrates a strange retelling of the legend of Momotaro with Misaki as the titular character herself.
Wanting to get Momo to open up to her, Yuko once again dives into her dream; this time she has to break through her outer defenses.
Sakura, an avid fan of rock band Yumemishi, is in love with its vocalist Kuuga. She invites her friends to a party with the band, but Kuuga has his eyes on Misaki instead.
Chasing after Momo after she runs off, Yuko proposes that she quit being a magical girl and become her vassal so she can search for Sakura.
Usui meets Misaki's mom and helps her, and she invites him home for tea. Misaki drags him from her home. When her friends see them leave together, what else would they think?
Keima and Elsie are saved from bullies by Kusunoki Kasuga.
It's the Sports Festival, and the boys have decided that the Grand Prize is a kiss from a horrified Sakura. Misaki competes to save her, despite all efforts to disqualify her.
Kusunoki becomes embarrassed on her date with Keima but continues it hoping it will draw out her feminine side; after failing to connect, Kusunoki and Keima jump to sharing an ice cream.
Aratake, the strongest delinquent in school, can't believe Naoya, a former gang leader, has gone soft; the gang abducts Yukimura, whom they mistake for Naoya's girlfriend.
Elsie meets her friend Haqua.
The Student Council plans an open house at Seika High to boost female enrollment. However, a girl-hating freshman, Soutarou, goes to extreme measures to derail their efforts.
Keima suggests Haqua should team up with Elsie, but she refuses.
Soutarou is shocked to find that Misaki was able to outlast his little game. Misaki has a special punishment in mind for the freshman at the upcoming Open House.
Keima learns there are still 60,000 spirits to be captured before his contract is finished.

Ayumi tries to lighten Keima's mood after his fight with Chihiro.

Keima prepares Chihiro to confess to Yuta.

Keima teaches Elsie about dating sims so she can buy him a rare version of "Love Tears" while he attends a game fair.

An idealistic new teacher becomes Keima's next target.

Keima has a plan to make Jun see him as an equal.

Keima and Jun take in a pro wrestling match where Keima exposes Jun's desire to help others as a desire to help herself.

Keima is asked by a game studio to help create the perfect dating sim game.

A chance encounter with a mysterious stranger introduces Ko to nocturnal life, leading him to explore the city at night.
Takumi narrates a strange retelling of the legend of Momotaro with Misaki as the titular character herself.
Nazuma remains frustratingly elusive, but Ko may have a nostalgic solution to this new problem.
Sakura, an avid fan of rock band Yumemishi, is in love with its vocalist Kuuga. She invites her friends to a party with the band, but Kuuga has his eyes on Misaki instead.
As Ko reconnects with a classmate, questions arise he isn't sure he knows how to answer.
Sakura wants to confess her feelings to her crush, Nozaki. Unfortunately, when she does, he thinks she is just a fan of his shojo manga.
Three's a crowd when Ko invites Akira to hang out with him and Nazuna late one evening.
Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.
Ko gets the inside scoop on Nazuna's business, but first he needs to make sense of his complicated emotions.
Sakura learns that she and Mikoshiba aren't the only ones helping Nozaki with his mangas. Concerned with who may be cozying up to Nozaki, Sakura is on a new mission.
Ko doesn't need a mirror to see his reflection; it's staring right back at him in the form of Nazuna's latest client.
Mikoshiba is invited to a mixer, but isn't sure about his social skills. Fortunately, with a little help from Nozaki and Sakura, he might be able to figure it out just enough.
Boredom drives Ko into the night; boredom drives Ko's new acquaintance into killing time in her own way; she and Ko seem very similar, perhaps too similar for comfort.
When Sakura notices that Nozaki's apartment is pristine, she panics, worried that he's trying to impress another girl. What she discovers is even more irritating.
Ko thinks he has all the time in the world, but the revelation of an unexpected deadline changes everything; hopefully his friends have some advice.
Nozaki gives Wakamatsu a gift to help him fight his insomnia, but what he doesn't tell him is that this gift may also be his worst nightmare.
Seri is extremely popular, but popularity isn't all it's cracked up to be when one of her human paramours develops feelings she isn't ready to deal with.
Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.
It's not all sparkles and hearts at the maid café where Midori works; someone is creeping on a certain maid, but uncovering the interloper isn't as easy as it looks.
Posing manga characters is a never-ending challenge for Nozaki, but two of his models may become a real life couple!
Nazuna needs new blood for her cuddle-buddy business, and Ko is on the case; but he's not the only one wandering the night looking for someone.
A chat with a friend reveals Ko's lack of answers to some all-important questions.
Sakura and Nozaki find themselves living in a real-life manga, but while Sakura daydreams of romance it's no surprise to find that Nozaki is completely clueless.
The night feels distant; Ko isn't sure how to close that gap.
The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.
Aoi, an assistant producer, faces the struggles of working within the anime industry.
Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
Segawa-san falls ill and the pressure to complete episode four increases for Aoi -- and the director has decided to completely redo a scene!
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.
Aoi and the team scramble to make their deadline after a server goes down and they can't access the necessary files.
Yuko didn't have horns or a tail when she went to bed last night! Now her mom's revealing the deep dark secret their family's been hiding for generations - What's going on!?
Shizuka auditions for a role with Prussia Studio and learns that a popular voice actress is auditioning as well.
Well it's time for Yuko to murderize a magical girl - but not before she gets in some exercise and spends her allowance, of course.
Endou-san drops out as animation supervisor for the eighth episode and the storyboards for the final episode are nowhere near finished.
Lilith contacts Yuko in her dreams with vital information she must remember. After all, Yuko needs all the help she can get! Say, why is Momo helping her anyways?
Endo-san refuses to return to work and is offered a position at Studio Canaan and Aoi is forced to tell Honda about everything.
Wait a minute; there's a switch on the bottom of Yuko's ancestor statue. What happens if it's turned on? Later, Yuko needs cash fast cause she owes Momo A LOT of money!
Aoi's sister suddenly decides to visit; Ochiai announces he'll be leaving the company; Ema begins to question her animation skills.
Momo finally meets Ryoko. Later, the accident-prone Yuko must carry a FRAGILE and VALUABLE laptop home with her. What could possibly go wrong?
Ema continues to struggle and Yumi offers her a new perspective; Aoi's troubles over Ochiai's announcement grow.
Yuko will need to go deeper into Momo's subconscious so she can implant the idea that will change everything! Perhaps compassion can triumph where fighting has failed.
A change of fortune can only mean one thing: FOOD. Later, Yuko learns the hard way that she and Momo have vastly different definitions of "training."
Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?
Aoi is tasked with delivering an instrument to the sound effects department; Misa contemplates quitting her job and Aoi gives her some advice.
Yuko and Momo finally resume their duel. In the end, there can be only one winner - who will receive the higher exam score? Later, Mikan takes Yuko to a zombie horror movie.
The deadline for the last episode is fast approaching and Aoi needs to distribute the key frames to the animators.
Look out Yuko, Shion's up to something - and she won't rest until she runs her experiments! Then, can Yuko and Momo keep a secret from Ryoko?
When Aoi apologizes to Kanno for asking for his help with the key frames, he tells her that there is someone perfect for the assignment.
